notes: The READER half of SPEC.md section 5. The committed `.kragg/history.jsonl` holds two complete entries and a third that stops mid-token, exactly as an interrupted run leaves it. A conforming reader skips the half-written final line rather than treating the file as corrupt, and both siblings must agree on that: crag's `read_runs` does the same. The two entries are hand-written rather than produced by a run, so the timestamps, shas and durations are fixed and the golden needs no normalization at all — which is also what makes this fixture a check on the reader instead of on the writer.
